Report.logicTickTimingScope: Synchronous SimulationTickDriver.StepOneTick elapsed time on the Unity main thread.

capacityPressure.scope: Post-warmup monotonic rejection/drop counters. Memory/capacity rejects fail the gate; intentional presentation throttles are reported separately.

Report.zeroGcGateScope: Main-thread allocation and GC.CollectionCount(0..2) gates for steady SimulationTickDriver.StepOneTick plus the formal battle memory boundary around driver Update non-tick work, LateUpdate presentation, and the early-Update through URP endFrameRendering PlayerLoop envelope. The envelope is observational in Editor because Editor callbacks share the main thread and is a hard gate in Player builds; stress diagnostics and report serialization are excluded from the narrow tick gate.
Report.roleAwareDirectCostTickScope: All successful logic ticks including warmup; mirrors role-aware direct/tree total tick counters.
Report.opointCounterReason: Runtime-derived observable proxy: unique active non-harness runtime handles observed after each logic tick. It is not a production opoint creation counter.

unityFrameMilliseconds.source: Time.unscaledDeltaTime for visible Play Mode frames

profilerFrameGcAllocatedBytes.source: ProfilerRecorder Memory/GC Allocated In Frame; one value per completed Profiler frame. Resolved category: Memory.

profilerFrameMainThreadGcAllocEventCount.source: ProfilerRecorder GC.Alloc with Default | CollectOnlyOnCurrentThread; the recorder is constructed and started by the runner on Unity's main thread; the exact handle has UnitType Bytes, while the reported metric is ProfilerRecorderSample.Count events per completed Profiler frame. Resolved category: .
profilerFrameMainThreadGcAllocEventCount.unavailableReason: The exact profiler metric GC.Alloc with UnitType Bytes was not discovered in preferred category Internal or any fallback category on this platform.

profilerFrameSetPassCallCount.source: Continuously running ProfilerRecorder Render/SetPass Calls Count; LastValue is read at the next MonoBehaviour.Update for the previously completed rendered frame. Resolved category: Render.

centralFrameSourceCommandCount.source: BattleCentralRenderSystem state captured at the next MonoBehaviour.Update after the rendered frame; values are actual central command, segment and render-pass submission counters, not Unity Statistics SetPass estimates.

centralFrameResolvedCommandCount.source: BattleCentralRenderSystem state captured at the next MonoBehaviour.Update after the rendered frame; values are actual central command, segment and render-pass submission counters, not Unity Statistics SetPass estimates.

centralFrameActiveChunkCount.source: BattleCentralRenderSystem state captured at the next MonoBehaviour.Update after the rendered frame; values are actual central command, segment and render-pass submission counters, not Unity Statistics SetPass estimates.

centralFrameSegmentCount.source: BattleCentralRenderSystem state captured at the next MonoBehaviour.Update after the rendered frame; values are actual central command, segment and render-pass submission counters, not Unity Statistics SetPass estimates.

centralFrameSubmissionDrawCount.source: BattleCentralRenderSystem state captured at the next MonoBehaviour.Update after the rendered frame; values are actual central command, segment and render-pass submission counters, not Unity Statistics SetPass estimates.

Report.frameTimingSource: Unity FrameTimingManager completed rendered frames requested by formal steady-state stress windows.
Report.frameTimingEvidenceAlignment: CaptureFrameTimings is requested immediately before a candidate formal logic-tick batch. The candidate is accepted only when the next MonoBehaviour.Update proves that every tick in that rendered frame passed the steady-state sample gate. A newer completed timing is then drained within four Unity frames; spawn, replenishment, cleanup, and incomplete windows are discarded.

completedFrameCpuMilliseconds.source: Unity FrameTimingManager completed rendered frames requested by formal steady-state stress windows. Field: FrameTiming.cpuFrameTime.
completedFrameCpuMilliseconds.unavailableReason: No positive completed-frame samples were accepted.

completedFrameMainThreadMilliseconds.source: Unity FrameTimingManager completed rendered frames requested by formal steady-state stress windows. Field: FrameTiming.cpuMainThreadFrameTime.
completedFrameMainThreadMilliseconds.unavailableReason: No positive completed-frame samples were accepted.

completedFrameRenderThreadMilliseconds.source: Unity FrameTimingManager completed rendered frames requested by formal steady-state stress windows. Field: FrameTiming.cpuRenderThreadFrameTime.
completedFrameRenderThreadMilliseconds.unavailableReason: No positive completed-frame samples were accepted.

completedFrameGpuMilliseconds.source: Unity FrameTimingManager completed rendered frames requested by formal steady-state stress windows. Field: FrameTiming.gpuFrameTime.
completedFrameGpuMilliseconds.unavailableReason: No positive completed-frame samples were accepted.

Report.profilerFrameGcEvidenceAlignment: GC recorder windows start immediately before a candidate formal logic-tick batch and stop at the beginning of the next MonoBehaviour.Update. SetPass remains continuously running because Unity commits the render counter after Update; the next Update reads LastValue for that completed rendered frame. Only windows whose logic ticks all passed the production steady-state sample gate are retained. Each exact recorder is accepted independently, so an unavailable marker cannot invalidate another metric. Report generation and teardown run only after Stop.
